useCases.sensing: prop and beam spacing, level of the soffit
useCases.reason: Props, beams and sheets of 8.5 to 26 kg set up to 3.5 m high, beams with forks from the floor and sheets from platform stairs or the deck, in the open, as a formwork that carries the fresh slab.

useCases.tool: locking hooks, spacer bolts, panel clamps and struts
useCases.reason: Panels of 22 to 185 kg hold up to 90 kN/m² of fresh concrete; the crane moves the whole unit and a crew locks and plumbs it among starter bars.

useCases.tool: pump end hose, vibrating screed or straightedge
useCases.sensing: slab level against laser or level marks, concrete flow
useCases.reason: Guiding an end hose that can whip while walking on rebar mats, then screeding the fresh concrete, in the open on a load-bearing slab; the screed weighs over 16.3 kg with its blade, the pump boom places the concrete, and crane-set laser screeds for elevated slabs are not listed for Germany.
